 "description": "Focuses on special education issues that arise in teaching infants and young children. Examines the identification process of special needs and the evidence-based practices available to support infants and young children with special needs in their natural settings. Offers students an opportunity to obtain knowledge of developmental and behavioral characteristics of infants and young children, birth to five years, who have disabilities or are at risk for developmental delay. Discusses related topics such as prenatal risk factors, assessment, individual family service plans (IFSP), individualized education programs (IEP), early intervention, preschool special education, and laws protecting individuals with disabilities.",
